categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction rebroadcast logic and mempool re-addition on startup.
categories.rationale: Fixes a long-standing privacy leak where nodes rebroadcasting incoming transactions allows attackers to link IP addresses to wallet ownership (#3828). While this addresses an active deanonymization vector, the delay of another cycle is not catastrophic given the issue's long-standing nature since 2014, making it strategically important rather than category-critical.
